title: Trade Schools | ContractorOps
description: Bring real-world business readiness into trade-school classrooms, from first contact to a clear payment record.
stage0title: Find a fit. Start a conversation.
stage0desc: ContractorOps finds businesses and drafts outreach from the campaign brief. Alex chooses the audience, checks the fit, and reviews the message in review mode.
stage0learn: Explore opportunities. Choose an audience. Review the message before reaching out.
stage1title: A reply becomes a useful lead.
stage1desc: Morgan replies about a leaking water heater. Alex keeps the conversation and details together, then asks what needs confirming before a visit.
stage1learn: Capture the problem. Qualify the work. Give the customer a clear next step.
stage2title: Turn interest into a clear plan.
stage2desc: Alex plans a one-hour water-heater inspection with Morgan for Thursday, October 15, 9-10 AM. They confirm rental access and arrival expectations before the visit.
stage2learn: Set expectations. Confirm availability, access, and scope.
stage3desc: After the sample inspection, Alex reviews a replacement scope and the $1,350 estimate before Morgan sees it.
stage3learn: Understand costs. Explain the price. Follow up professionally.
stage4desc: After Morgan approves the estimate, Alex completes the replacement on Friday, October 16. Alex records the $1,350 payment and sees a zero balance.
stage4learn: Track invoices, payments, and outstanding balances.
approval: Thu, Oct 15 · Sent to Morgan after inspection. Morgan approves before Friday work.
